DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_LanternButler:
Its lantern glows with an eerie light that lays bare the truth of the world.
If that light strikes you as blinding, then you most likely have something to hide.

Lays <itemName id=|Egg| style=|Status_Keyword|/>'s when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.

DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_LanternButler:
While in party, 
the player's arrows <Status_Keyword>explode on contact</>, dealing additional damage equal to <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> of the player's attack damage. 
(Does not stack)

Lays <itemName id=|Egg| style=|Status_Keyword|/>'s when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
